|colspan="6" align="left" style="width:50px;"|'''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|negate|1}} Because of Sara's evacuation, Mickaël's black vote was negated.<br />
{{note|rewardtie|2}} Both tribes returned from their trek with the same number of amulets. Both tribes split the reward, with Sungaï taking 4 kg of rice and Mawar having a feast on a boat.<br />
{{note|ambassador|3}} At the ambassador's meeting, Anthony and Javier had to decide on a castaway to eliminate. They couldn't come up with a castaway, which ended with a rock drawing, eliminating Anthony.<br />
{{note|idol|4}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.<br />
{{note|negate2|5}} Because Philippe won immunity, Marie's black vote was negated.<br />
{{note|negate3|6}} Because Philippe won immunity, Marylou's black vote was negated.<br />
{{note|elim|7}} Due to the Tied Destinies twist, Camille was eliminated since she was Catherine's partner.<br />
{{note|idol2|8}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, however, no votes were cast against its user.<br />
{{note|final5|9}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge, where two castaways would be<br />eliminated. Bernard and Philippe came in last and were eliminated.<br />
{{refend}}
